objective: Preallocate obsolete SSTable deletion path buffers from the current obsolete list length.

tasks.title: Preallocate obsolete SSTable path buffer
tasks.result: Obsolete SSTable cleanup now creates the deletion path buffer with capacity for the current obsolete SSTable list.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The path buffer capacity comes from obsolete.len() while holding the obsolete_sstables write lock.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for paths ready to delete; Arc strong-count checks, retained obsolete SSTables, deletion order, and file removal semantics are unchanged.
